test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 1 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Aushadhi Scheme comes under which ministry?

options.text: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Chemical and Fertilizers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Jan-Aushadhi Scheme is implemented by the **Ministry of Chemical and Fertilizers** under the Department of Pharmaceuticals.
 
• The scheme aims to provide **quality medicines at affordable prices** through special outlets known as Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Kendras (PMBJKs).
 
• It was launched in **2008** and has since expanded to thousands of outlets across India.
 
• The scheme targets to **reduce out-of-pocket expenditure on medicines** for the common man, particularly the poor and disadvantaged sections of the society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Finance**

 
 
• The Ministry of Finance is responsible for the management of the finances of the Government of India, including the preparation of the annual Budget.
 
• It oversees various departments such as the Department of Economic Affairs, Department of Expenditure, Department of Revenue, and Department of Financial Services.
 
• The Ministry is also in charge of financial regulations, taxation, and economic policies.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare**
 
 
• This Ministry is responsible for policy formulation, implementation, and oversight of agriculture and farmers' welfare in India.
 
• It aims to increase the income of farmers and ensure food security through various schemes and initiatives.
 
• Key schemes include PM-KISAN, National Food Security Mission, and Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs**
 
 
• The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs is responsible for urban development and housing policies in India.
 
• It oversees major urban initiatives such as Smart Cities Mission, AMRUT, and Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban).
 
• The Ministry aims to promote sustainable urbanization and improve the quality of life in urban areas.
